Name: Khajiit
Description: Hailing from the province of Elsweyr, they are intelligent, quick and agile. They make excellent thieves due to their natural agility and unmatched acrobatics skill. All Khajiit can see in the dark.
Origins:
Anequina: The harsh region where you lived and trained hardened your body and taught you how to defend yourself, with your bare fists or any weapon you could find.

Pellitine: Your parents lived in Pellitine and your childhood memories are filled playing and running around in the jungles or on the pristine beaches.
